notes: Independent saved-art critic, Part A round 1. Reviewed BRIEF-17 in full, panel 1, COURSE.md, and the earlier-round method sections in NOTES.md; panel 2 does not exist. FAIL: 10 designs / 40 exports, including each unsuffixed c0 alias and explicit c0/c1/c2. All 240 Part A PNGs have an entry; 200 pass. Inspected all 182 distinct pixel images at literal 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x in galleries verified against the current PNG bytes; 58 remaining exports are byte-identical pixel aliases. Compared with fantasy-house-2, including the full sample building at matching 1x/4x. Used native-coordinate 8x close-ups for small entrances and suspect clusters. Inspected literal 3x3 repeats of all 40 ground/inn/corner designs in all three colourways (unsuffixed aliases are exact c0), plus per-export self/colour/layout seam sheets. These facades are architecture, not seamless terrain textures: intentional doors, windows and lot contours repeating in a forced 3x3 grid are not by themselves failures. The eight trade symbols are nameable at 1x and were inspected over summer grass and mounted on the approved blank facade bay; their final PNGs pass. There are no Part A terrain bases or seasonal partners, so seasonal-ground/seasonal-silhouette tests are not applicable. Code compared all 116 c1/c2 facade alpha masks against c0 with zero mismatches. Independent technical checks: 240/240 correct RGBA dimensions (48/96/144x48 facades, 8x48 ends, 32x40 signs); alpha only 0/255; zero RGB beneath transparency; one connected painted component per PNG; 8-31 opaque colours; exact COURSE.md bytes on both rows 0/47 for every non-sign export. All same-width joins therefore share the same contact rows. No alpha seam, rounded external grid corner, detached alpha speck, haze or fog found. The supplied source-processing code uses magenta keying, painted-row registration, 8x BOX working canvases, fixed palette quantisation, exact 64-sample RGBA mode and contour/fleck cleanup; no replacement shape/noise drawing was found in that pipeline. This review does not claim a fresh replay of all source reductions. Verified all 13 fantasy reference crops directly against the requested Git object and current-town.png against the exact 600x500 fantasy-panel crop. Rebuilt all three critic scenes in memory with city17/compose.py: each equals the saved 1x scene byte-for-byte, and every saved 3x scene is exact nearest-neighbour. Inspected all three at 1x and 3x (large 3x views split into literal crops), their 1x greyscale squint renders, and the round15/current-town baselines. Full-city acceptance still FAILS: L-block exposes ground behind facades, lacks convincing rear/side mass, and a foreground roof obscures part of the central row; the height tests have no firewall or cast street shadow; the market proxies do not dominate the square and the oversized paving competes with the architecture in greyscale; no finished gate is present. These are recorded B/C/D dependencies, not additional failures assigned to A PNG basenames. The actual placeholders are R15 roof/chimney/dormer art, current fantasy ground textures and halls/well/stalls; missing walls/shadows/landmarks were not fabricated. Brief precedence: keep the mandated identical course rows despite the panel suggestion to remove repeated belts; the explicit complete Part A set takes precedence over the panel 40-60-piece cap. That precedence does not excuse the entrance, inn-program or painted-cluster failures listed here. Evidence: critic-r17A-1-repeats-01..10.png, critic-r17A-1-seams-01..23.png, critic-r17A-1-entrances-8x-1..3.png, critic-r17A-1-wide-fronts-1..5.png, critic-r17A-1-detail-*.png, and critic-r17A-1-<scene>-3x-*.png. No city17 file was edited; no commit, push or branch change.
